svg.text: QKVParallelLinear: which heads each TP rank owns
32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head size 128 · colour = KV head (GQA group of 4 query heads)
per rank: q_size = num_heads x 128, kv_size = num_kv_heads x 128, output = q_size + 2 x kv_size
TP = 2: every rank gets 16 query heads and 4 KV heads; nothing is copied
num_heads = 32 / 2 = 16, num_kv_heads = 8 / 2 = 4, num_kv_head_replicas = 1. qkv_proj.weight per rank: [3072, 4096].
k, v rows 0-511 of k_proj, v_proj
k, v rows 512-1023 of k_proj, v_proj
TP = 16: each rank gets 2 query heads; each KV head is copied to 2 ranks
tp_size >= 8 KV heads: num_kv_heads = 1, num_kv_head_replicas = 16 / 8 = 2. qkv_proj.weight per rank: [512, 4096].
q heads: rank r takes heads 2r and 2r+1 (slice index = tp_rank).
k, v: rank r takes KV head r // 2 (slice index = tp_rank // num_kv_head_replicas).
The query heads of a rank always use the KV head that the same rank holds: heads 2r, 2r+1 -> KV head r // 2.
KV cache: each rank stores 1 KV head per layer, so the 16 ranks store 16 copies of the 8 real KV heads (2 of each).
Numbers in cells are query head ids; k3 and v3 are the key and value of KV head 3. Query head h uses KV head h // 4 (grouped-query attention).
TP = 8 (not shown): 4 query heads and exactly 1 KV head per rank, replicas = 1. TP = 3 fails: 32 heads do not divide by 3.
